newsitem.title: UK: UK lottery policy paper in next two weeks.
newsitem.headline: UK lottery policy paper in next two weeks.

text.p: The British government will publish a policy White Paper within a fortnight on the future of the National Lottery after operator Camelot Group Plc's franchise expires, a National Heritage Department spokeswoman said on Tuesday.
She said the government would seek a "not-for-profit operator" after the 2001 expiry of the franchise, as promised in the Labour Party's manifesto for the May 1 election.
But she declined to comment further on press speculation that such an operator might be offered a flat management fee, possibly coupled with performance-related bonuses.
The Financial Times said on Tuesday there were signs that the government would look favourably on Camelot extending its franchise on some such basis.
Camelot is a consortium formed by Racal Electronics, De La Rue, GTECH, Cadbury Schweppes and Fujitsu Ltd's ICL. -- London Newsroom +44 171 5427767
